Use exactly 2 persistent teammates with configured roles (implementer, reviewer). Read start.md once. Call start_team with one assignment per role; it creates owned tasks and delivers delegation messages. Delegate source implementation and a single import check to the implementer, and behavioral verification to the reviewer. The reviewer starts after the implementer hands off. Members use finish_teammate once to complete their tasks and send reports automatically. Then call wait_agent target=all once. Do not poll. Integrate their delivered findings and give a concise final result. This run validates benchmark operation, not maximum score. Produce a complete initial repository attempt, perform one review pass, and finish with known failures recorded. Failing repository tests do not mean the agent or benchmark failed. Do not pursue repeated type-checking or repair loops until all tests pass. The lead collects reports and finishes without redoing implementation or checks. If required files were not attempted, report that honestly.
